starter.journal_entry: Took up the road — no family waiting, so the Hollow spends me freely.

controls.overworld: Touch MOVE arrows · INTERACT · MENU · CODEX | keyboard: WASD/arrows, Space, Esc, Tab
controls.battle: Touch COMMANDS and PAUSE · keyboard: Enter/Space and P
controls.battle_menu: Touch a row or UP/DOWN, then SELECT · BACK returns
controls.codex: Touch CLOSE CODEX · keyboard: Tab / Esc · 1-8 jump
